name: Pampanga Speedcubing Open 2025
information:
Pampanga Speedcubing Open 2025 returns as the exciting sequel to last year’s successful competition, once again hosted by the [Cabalen Cubers Club](https://www.facebook.com/CabalenCubersClub).

Building on the momentum of 2024, this WCA-sanctioned event brings together speedcubers from all over the country to showcase their skills in a spirit of friendly competition. Held in the vibrant province of Pampanga, the event celebrates precision, passion, and the ever-growing cubing community in the region.
